title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
content:
## Present Perfect vs Past Simple

Compare unspecified time and life experience with finished actions at a specific past time.

### Lesson focus

1. Present perfect: I have lost my wallet.
2. Past simple: I lost my wallet yesterday.
3. Present perfect: She has made a cake.
4. Past simple: She made a cake for his birthday.
5. Present perfect: They have visited Paris.
6. Past simple: They visited Paris early summer.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
